name: dev.pages.hodoyoku/japan-data
title: Hodoyoku Japan data
description: Official Japan ticket openings, closures, and JMA warnings for agents, paid via x402.

tools.name: get_japan_ticket_drops
tools.description: Upcoming official Japan ticket, anime/manga, and food reservation openings in JST. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_japan_business_calendar
tools.description: Official Japan national holidays and typical government and bank closures, in JST. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_japan_weather_warnings
tools.description: Active official JMA weather warnings and advisories for one Japan forecast office, in English. Changes through the day. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402. Use office code or area name; call list_japan_warning_offices first if needed.

area.description: English or Japanese area name, e.g. Tokyo

tools.name: get_japan_minimum_wage
tools.description: Official Japan regional minimum wage (JPY/hour) in force on a date (JST) for one prefecture, or all 47 if pref is omitted. Handles staggered FY2026 effective dates and returns the next pending revision plus overtime/night premium rules, with MHLW source URLs. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

pref.description: JIS code 1-47 (e.g. 13) or English/Japanese name (e.g. Tokyo, 東京都). Omit for all 47.

tools.name: get_japan_worker_rights
tools.description: Know-before-you-work data for foreign workers in Japan: minimum wages, labour rights with e-Gov law citations (premiums, passport retention, wage payment), native-language help desks, and job-change rules by visa status. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: get_japan_earthquakes
tools.description: Recent felt earthquakes in Japan from official JMA reports, in English: time (JST), epicenter, magnitude, depth, max seismic intensity (shindo) and per-prefecture intensity. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

pref.description: Optional prefecture: JIS code 1-47 or English/Japanese name (e.g. Tokyo)

tools.name: list_japan_warning_offices
tools.description: Free list of 58 JMA forecast offices you can query with get_japan_weather_warnings.
